title: Faction Systems Reporting
Enable Faction Systems Reporting
desc: If ON and Faction Name and Faction Systems Bookmark Groups are set below, will run background checks on your faction's systems and produce status reporting of standing in each system

title: Faction Systems Bookmark Groups
desc: Name of the Bookmark Groups that will be created and automatically populated with a list of your faction's systems. If you want to create multiple bookmark groups, each for a different faction, set this value BEFORE you update the Faction Name below.

title: Faction Name
desc: Name of your faction (case sensitive, as displayed on Inara)

title: Auto create 'Faction Systems To Visit' bookmark group
desc: If ON, will create a bookmark group called 'Faction Systems To Visit' on completion of the system checks, containing systems not visited in the last x hours, where x = either a) time since last tick + tolerance or b) constant defined in Faction Revisit Threshold setting

title: Use Last Tick + Tolerance for checking and reporting
desc: If ON, will use elapsed time since the last tick, plus the Last Tick Tolerance, to re-check faction systems or create groups of systems not visited in that elapsed time

title: Last Tick Tolerance (0 to 5 hours)
desc: Set a tolerance level to add to the elapsed hours since last tick when checking systems or creating 'not visited' bookmark groups

title: Faction Revisit Threshold
desc: If Last Tick is OFF, will determine whether to include a faction system in your 'Faction Systems To Visit' bookmark group, if number of hours since that system was last visited exceeds this number (range 1 to 50 hours)

title: Delta Gap Threshold
desc: If the delta between your faction and your rivals is less than this, then the row will be highlighted on the Faction Systems panel (range 1 to 100 percent)

title: Low Influence Threshold
desc: Will list systems with influence less than this, when you request a post of low influence systems to Discord (range 1 to 100 percent)

title: BGS Information source provider
desc: You can switch providers if you are experiencing issues with data retreval

title: Discord Webhooks
Faction Status URL - Discord webhook URL to post status message
desc: Enter the URL of the Discord webhook here, to be able to auto post Faction status messages from the FSR panel

title: Faction Work Order - additional Discord message text
desc: Enter a custom message to be inclded with the Faction Wor Order post on Discord

title: Faction War Image - image to post with War notice
desc: Click here to set an image to post on Discord above your War notice

title: Faction War Notice - additional Discord message text
desc: Enter a custom message to be inclded with the Faction War Notice post on Discord

title: Faction Election Notice - additional Discord message text
desc: Enter a custom message to be inclded with the Faction Election Notice post on Discord

title: Faction Election Image - image to post with Election notice
desc: Click here to set an image to post on Discord above your Election notice

title: Faction Systems To Visit URL - Discord webhook URL to post 'Faction Systems To Visit' status messages
desc: Enter the URL of the Discord webhook here, to be able to auto post list of Faction Systems To Visit

title: Screenshot upload URL - Discord webhook URL to post screenshots
desc: Enter the URL of the Discord webhook here, for sharing your screenshots
